t: This is the pedestrian entrance and garden wall to The Elms, in Camden. It was designed by George Basevi, a pupil of Sir John Soane who worked in both Neoclassical and Gothic Revival styles. Basevi lived from 1794 to 1845, and his designs include Belgrave Square in London and the Fitzwilliam Museum in Cambridge. So this modest gateway and wall come from the same hand as some far grander works. I don't have more detail about the house behind, so just enjoy the entrance itself.
